name: Deuce Go-Karting
description: Race on our winding 350-meter asphalt track with professional grade electronic lap timing and high-torque pro-karts.
safetyInstructions: Helmets and safety harnesses must be tightly secured at all times.
Never step out of the kart while on the racing track.
No intentional bumping, blocking, or dangerous maneuvering.
Obey the track marshal flags immediately (Red: Stop, Yellow: Slow down).

packages.name: Single Rider Experience (5 Mins)
packages.description: Classic single-seat kart session with lap analysis.

packages.name: Double Co-Pilot Ride (5 Mins)
packages.description: Twin-seater kart perfect for a parent and child pairing.

packages.name: Grand Prix Tournament (15Mins)
packages.description: Warm-up, qualifying session, and an 8-lap medal race.

name: Precision Air Gun Shooting
description: Test your focus and aim in a professional, safety-hardened indoor air gun shooting range with electronic target retrieval.
safetyInstructions: Keep the gun pointed downrange at all times.
Do not place your finger on the trigger until you are ready to fire.
Always wear the provided protective eye-goggles.
Treat every air rifle as if it were fully loaded at all times.

packages.name: Starter Aim (15 Shots)
packages.description: Great for beginners looking to learn basic trigger control.

packages.name: Sharp Shooter (30 Shots)
packages.description: Our most popular range package with professional coaching.

packages.name: Marksman Elite (50 Shots)
packages.description: Advanced targets, high-grade ammo, and full score analysis.

name: Royal Horse Riding
description: Experience guided horseback rides through scenic nature trails under expert handler supervision. Perfect for families, beginners, and seasoned riders alike.
safetyInstructions: Always wear the provided certified riding helmet.
Approach the horse from the front-side, never from directly behind.
Avoid sudden movements or loud noises while near the horses.
Maintain upright posture and keep both feet securely in the stirrups.

name: BIKE SIMIMULATORS
description: Experience the thrill of bike riding in a realistic virtual environment with exciting tracks, challenges, and immersive simulation.
